def priority(f):
    p = f['progress']
    d = f['cluster_density']
    dist = f['distance']
    ret = f['return_distance']
    near = f['nearest_remaining']
    mean = f['mean_remaining']
    reg = f['regret']
    rw = 0.1 + 0.6 * p
    rgw = (0.1 + 0.2 * p) * (0.5 + 0.5 * d)

    s = f['spread']
    cd = f['cluster_density']
    d = f['distance']
